GrantScopes.description_en: The collection of API authorization scopes

items.description_en:
The API authorization scope. Valid values:
urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:user:read_all: the permission to query all users.
urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:user:manage_all: the permission to manage all users.
urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:organizational_unit:read_all: the permission to query all organizational units.
urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:organizational_unit:manage_all: the permission to manage all organizational units
items.description_zh:
API授权范围，取值可选范围：
urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:user:read_all -查询所有用户的权限。
urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:user:manage_all  -管理所有用户的权限。
urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:organizational_unit:read_all  -查询所有组织机构的权限。
urn:alibaba:idaas:scope:organizational_unit:manage_all  -管理所有组织机构的权限
